newsitem.title: USA: Tosco hydrocracker seen up in week - source.
newsitem.headline: Tosco hydrocracker seen up in week - source.

text.p: A hydrocracker at Tosco Corp's Wilmington, Calif., refinery could restart within a week following a fire April 3 which damaged the unit's pump, said a source familiar with plant operations.
"(The shutdown) may be as short as a week," said the source, who declined to be identified.
The 25,000 bpd unit shut after leaking diesel fuel sparked the fire.
The plant's crude distillation capacity is 120,000 bpd.
Workers have removed the pump and begun to inspect fire damage, which is not considered serious, according to the source.
There were no injuries in the fire and whole gasoline prices last Friday were not strengthened by the supply disruption, according to market players.
CARB gasoline in Los Angeles was talked 72 to 74 cents a gallon Friday, down two cents on the day.
